names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 30 octombrie, «Sfânta Muceniţă Zenovia, sora Sfântului Mucenic Zenovie».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 30 Οκτωβρίου, «Άγιοι Ζηνόβιος και Ζηνοβία τα αδέλφια», with the rank word left off.

Read out of the title on her name link behind the line for 30 октября ст. ст., «Зиновия Егейская (Киликийская), мц.», with the rank word left off. The line itself declines the name and gives her no by-name at all; the two forms of the see are the link's.

Read out of the Охридски пролог’s heading for 30. октобар ст. ст., „Свешт. муч. Зиновије и сестра му Зиновија.“ — the heading’s rank words, «Свешт. муч.», govern her brother, and what it gives her is «сестра му», his sister, which is a relationship and not part of her name. So the bare name is the whole of the form. `foldchk.py` returns `NO FOLDER HOLDS THIS FORM`, and it is also a different string from her brother’s «Зиновије», which the gate folds to a different key, so the pair do not collide with each other.

feast.note: The Greek and Romanian calendars keep the pair on their own 30 October; this is the Russian calendar's own day for the same pair and not a second day on one calendar. The life page the two share is headed «День памяти: 30 октября» and lists no other.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 30 октября ст. ст. — «Сщмч. Зиновия , еп. Егейского, и сестры его Зиновии (285).»
source.note: The line is the first of the day and names her as the bishop's sister, without a rank word of her own; the abbreviation «Мц.» for her comes from her name link. The day carries one typikon sign only, «Cовершается служба, не отмеченная в Типиконе никаким знаком», so no rank is recorded.

attestations.note: The Russian agrees with the Greek and Romanian days this folder was written from and adds what they did not have: that she and her brother were brought up in the faith by their parents, that she asked to share his torture when she saw it rather than being arrested with him, that she confessed before the persecutors without fear, and that the two of them survived a red-hot bed and a boiling cauldron before they were beheaded. The year is the same 285 the folder already held, now stated by a second calendar.

source.text: doxologia.ro, 30 octombrie — «Sfânta Muceniţă Zenovia, sora Sfântului Mucenic Zenovie»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 30ης Οκτωβρίου — «Άγιοι Ζηνόβιος και Ζηνοβία τα αδέλφια»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 30 Οκτωβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder's Romanian row already carries, and the woman is the folder's own: the sister of Zenobius of Aegae, who came before the authorities of her own will while he was in prison, wanting to suffer with him. A `dates` object is proposed from this page where the folder had none. The page records a fragment of her relics at the monastery of Kato Xenia at Almyros in Magnesia, separately from her brother's. Both hymns name the two of them and are taken into both folders; the Οἶκος is neither a troparion nor a kontakion and is not drafted. No asterisk and not the sentence «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη η ύπαρξη του Αγίου».

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 12.11.2025 (30. октобар ст. ст.) — „Свешт. муч. Зиновије и сестра му Зиновија.“

attestations.note: The day’s first entry, the second of the two people it enumerates: «Свешт. муч. Зиновије и сестра му Зиновија» — and his sister Zenobia. The heading NAMES her, which is what earns her a row of her own; the row quotes the whole heading, the same string the `zenobius-of-aegae` row carries. `types` UNTOUCHED, AND THE RANK WORD DOES NOT REACH HER. «Свешт. муч.» is `hieromartyr` and governs her brother, who was the bishop; what the heading gives her is a relationship, «сестра му». She keeps the `martyr` and `virgin` she already held and gains nothing, and NO `hieromartyr` was written on a woman the book does not ordain. `dates` UNTOUCHED: `death` 285 flat on the folder, «око 285. год.» in the book, applied to both of them in one sentence — the same number more loosely stated, which changes nothing. WHAT THE BOOK ADDS, AND IT IS HER ONE SPEECH. She shares the inheritance, the almsgiving and the covering hand of God with her brother in the entry’s first sentences. Then, WHEN ZENOBIUS WAS ALREADY UNDER THE BITTER TORMENTS, SHE CAME FORWARD TO THE JUDGE OF HER OWN ACCORD and said „Ту чашу страдања и ја хоћу да испијем, и венцем тим да се венчам“ — that cup of suffering I too wish to drink, and with that crown to be crowned. She was not arrested with him; she presented herself. After torments in fire and in boiling pitch both were beheaded. NO NEW `related`: `zenobius-of-aegae` is already related both ways and is linked in the new paragraph. No `office`, no `locations`. THE FORM IS FREE: `foldchk.py` returns `NO FOLDER HOLDS THIS FORM` for «Зиновија», and the brother’s «Зиновије» is a different string, so the two do not fold onto one another either. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion; the day’s verse is Bishop Nikolai’s own and is about king Milutin.

hymns.text: Mucenicii Tăi, Doamne, întru nevoinţele lor, cununile nesctricăciunii au dobândit de la Tine, Dumnezeul nostru. Că având tăria Ta, pe chinuitori au învins; zdrobit-au şi ale demonilor neputincioase îndrăzniri. Pentru rugăciunile lor, mântuieşte sufletele noastre, Hristoase Dumnezeule.

source.text: doxologia.ro, Troparul Sfântului Sfințit Mucenic Zenovie, Episcopul Ciliciei, și al Sfintei Mucenițe Zenovia, sora sa, Glasul 4

english.text: Thy martyrs, O Lord, in their contest received incorruptible crowns from Thee our God; for possessing Thy strength they overthrew their torturers, and broke the feeble daring of the demons. By their prayers save Thou our souls, O Christ God.

hymns.text: Ὡς θεῖοι αὐτάδελφοι ὁμονοοῦντες καλῶς, Ζηνόβιε ἔνδοξε καὶ Ζηνοβία σεμνή, συμφώνως ἠθλήσατε· ὅθεν καὶ τῶν στεφανῶν τῶν ἀφθάρτων τυχόντες, δόξης ἀκαταλύτου ἠξιώθητε, ἅμα ἐκλάμποντες τοῖς ἐν κόσμῳ χάριν ἰάσεων.

source.text: saint.gr, Ἀπολυτίκιον (Κατέβασμα), Ἦχος δ’, Ταχὺ προκατάλαβε — the first hymn on the page of «Άγιοι Ζηνόβιος και Ζηνοβία τα αδέλφια». It names the two of them and no other saint.

english.text: As godly brother and sister well agreed together, glorious Zenobius and modest Zenobia, you contended with one voice; and so, having obtained the incorruptible crowns, you were counted worthy of indissoluble glory, shining out together upon those in the world with the grace of healings.

hymns.text: Τοὺς ἀληθείας Μάρτυρας, καὶ εὐσεβείας κήρυκας, τῶν ἀδελφῶν τὴν δυάδα τιμήσωμεν, ἐν θεοπνεύστοις ᾄσμασι, τὸν Zηvόβιοv ἅμα τῇ σεπτῇ Zηνοβία, ὁμοῦ βιώσαντας, καὶ διὰ μαρτυρίου τευξαμένους στέφος ἄφθαρτον.

source.text: saint.gr, Κοντάκιον, Ἦχος πλ. δ’, Ὡς ἀπαρχὰς — on the page of «Άγιοι Ζηνόβιος και Ζηνοβία τα αδέλφια». It names the two of them and no other saint. The readings «Zηvόβιοv» and «Zηνοβία» with Latin letters among the Greek are the page's own and are copied as they stand.

english.text: Let us honour in God-inspired songs the martyrs of the truth and heralds of godliness, the pair of brother and sister, Zenobius together with the revered Zenobia, who lived together and by martyrdom obtained the incorruptible crown.

hymns.text: Мученицы Твои, Господи,/ во страданиих своих венцы прияша нетленныя от Тебе, Бога нашего,/ имуще бо крепость Твою,/ мучителей низложиша,/ сокрушиша и демонов немощныя дерзости,/ тех молитвами// спаси души наша.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 30 октября ст. ст. — «Тропарь священномученика Зиновия и мученицы Зиновии». The text is the common of martyrs and names neither of them; it is printed under their names on the day page and is copied whole, as the brief directs.

english.text: Your martyrs, O Lord, received from You, our God, crowns that do not fade, for in their sufferings they had Your strength; they threw down their torturers and broke the feeble insolence of the demons. By their prayers, save our souls.

hymns.text: Истины свидетели и благочестия проповедники,/ двоицу достойно почтим в богодухновенных песнех,/ Зиновия вкупе с мудрою Зиновиею,/ купно жившия и отшедшия// и мучением приимшия венец нетленный.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 30 октября ст. ст. — «Кондак священномученика Зиновия и мученицы Зиновии»

english.text: Witnesses of the truth and preachers of godliness, let us honour the two of them worthily in God-inspired songs: Zenobius together with the wise Zenobia, who lived together and departed together, and by their martyrdom received the crown that does not fade.

death.note: saint.gr's heading for her, «Αγια Ζηνοβια (; - 285)», and in the notice «Και οι δύο θανατώθηκαν με αποκεφαλισμό κατόπιν βασανιστηρίων το 285 μ.Χ.». The page sets the pair «την εποχή του Διοκλητιανού», whose reign begins in 284.
